proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three obligations are for the same straight-line accessor and use one inverse helper family: split a dll segment at the distinguished node, then reassemble the same segment after reading node_next. Keeping the entail and both return branches together lets one worker prove and reuse the suffixed split/join/same-stop helpers. Three witnesses are within the controller limit of 12.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed dllseg focus and reassembly helpers by induction on nodes_before, plus a same-stop elimination helper by destructing the logical node list. Open xizi_dll and focus at linklist_node for the entailment. For return_wit_1, use node_next = linklist to eliminate nodes_after as nil, unfold xizi_double_link_next_value, reassemble the prefix and distinguished node, and close xizi_dll when sentinel links are present. For return_wit_2, rewrite nodes_after = node_next :: l0 where available, fold the successor segment from its links and tail, simplify xizi_double_link_next_value, reassemble, and close xizi_dll in the full-list disjunct.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall first head last nodes_before node nodes_after, xizi_dllseg first head head last (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after) |-- EX node_prev node_next, xizi_dllseg first head node node_prev nodes_before ** xizi_dll_links node node_next node_prev ** xizi_dllseg node_next node head last nodes_after

forall first head node node_prev node_next last nodes_before nodes_after, xizi_dllseg first head node node_prev nodes_before ** xizi_dll_links node node_next node_prev ** xizi_dllseg node_next node head last nodes_after |-- xizi_dllseg first head head last (nodes_before ++ node :: nodes_after)
forall stop prev last nodes, xizi_dllseg stop prev stop last nodes |-- “ nodes = nil /\ prev = last ” && emp

premise_discharge.focus_node: The input xizi_dll owns a segment whose logical list is exactly nodes_before ++ linklist_node :: nodes_after; induction on nodes_before exposes the distinguished node without extra assumptions.
premise_discharge.same_stop: After rewriting node_next = linklist, the suffix segment begins and ends at linklist; the nil branch of XiziDLL.dllseg yields nodes_after = nil, node_prev = last, and emp, while the cons branch contradicts node <> stop.
premise_discharge.nonlast_successor: PreH1 gives nodes_after = node_next :: l0 and PreH2 gives node_next <> linklist; the two node_next field stores and tail segment are exactly the nonempty dllseg fold resources. Any address-validity side condition is discharged from the owned field stores by the standard entailer/store facts used by the existing double-link strategy proofs.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_next_entail_wi: Open xizi_dll, apply the focus helper to its segment, instantiate node_prev/node_next and sentinel first/last, then unfold xizi_dll_links and cancel the six requested resources. The second disjunct is the same focus operation without sentinel links.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_next_return_wi: Rewrite node_next = linklist; apply same-stop to obtain nodes_after = nil and emp; simplify xizi_double_link_next_value nil to 0; apply reassembly and xizi_dll_close for the first disjunct, and reassembly alone for the segment disjunct.

For the explicit nonempty-suffix disjunct rewrite nodes_after = node_next :: l0, simplify the value function, fold node_next's links plus tail into the suffix segment, and apply reassembly. The full-list disjunct uses the already-owned suffix segment directly, then closes xizi_dll.
